correctness.rationale: For the edge conjugation operation, adjacent distinct edges multiply to their third triangle edge. If their images collapse, equivariance forces the whole source to collapse. Distinct images of an n-1>=4 star for n>=5 form a common target star, and disjoint-source-edge commutation makes their centers distinct, forcing a unique vertex injection. For n=3, all nonconstant images are a triangle. For n=4, injective homomorphisms are vertex injections; any noninjective but nonconstant kernel identifies only opposite edges, and S4 action forces all three opposite-edge pairs to collapse, giving precisely T3. Section restrictions to the four triangles yield 24 rank-three T4 endomorphisms with product S3 times a four-element left-zero semigroup and four idempotents. Independently enumerated ALL maps by multiplication-table identities for (n,m)=(3,3),(3,4),(4,3),(4,4), recovering counts and ranks. The proof, not the finite cases, covers all n,m.
